title: Sample-efficient proper PAC verification of unions of intervals
author: Saachi Mutreja and Jonathan Shafer
source_version: Theory of Computing 22 (2026), Article 5, publisher source publication July 10, 2026; DOI 10.4086/toc.2026.v022a005

source_locator.proof_scope: Complete author argument including supplied core constructions

difficulty_reason: The verification construction compresses the population into a prover-supplied labeled interval discretization and checks it through tolerant identity testing, while preserving the losses of every union of d intervals. Its full author core tracks the endpoint-crossing error, the total-variation transfer and proper empirical minimization, rather than assuming that an untrusted approximate distribution is faithful. The source also gives the complete prover/verifier protocol and explicitly explains a point-mass extension, so the main research obstacle is a sample-efficient untrusted-discretization reduction with source-specific completeness and soundness budgets.
